text: Randomized ranking policies distribute exposure across documents. Expected exposure depends on position weights and mixture probabilities.
A ranking policy can preserve unsupported candidate positions while reranking documents with available source scores.
Independent policy verification reconstructs expected exposure from serialized ranking mixtures and checks a reference regret budget.
A budgeted retrieval pipeline retrieves candidates with BM25 and scores a smaller candidate subset using a second stage model.
Missing source scores indicate absent coverage. A score of zero is still an observed source score.
TREC run files exchange query identifiers document identifiers ordinal ranks and retrieval scores between research tools.
Conformal risk control uses calibration observations. Exchangeability assumptions differ from pointwise worst case guarantees.
A certificate constrains expected metric regret but does not establish empirical improvement or guarantee each sampled ranking.
Research artifacts need installation instructions versioned releases licenses and reproducible examples.
Source score fusion combines multiple scoring systems. Reciprocal rank fusion uses ordinal rank information.
BM25 uses term frequency document frequency and document length to score lexical matches.
TF IDF cosine similarity compares normalized sparse text vectors with unigram and bigram features.
User studies examine whether another researcher can integrate software into an existing experimental workflow.
Sorting expected exposures produces a deterministic ranking that need not inherit the stochastic policy certificate.
Birkhoff decomposition recovers a distribution over permutations from a doubly stochastic assignment matrix.
Engineering benchmarks separate solver time decomposition time serialization overhead and memory use.
A complete reference ranking defines the candidate universe. The risk budget is measured in absolute expected nDCG units.
News recommendation experiments can have concentrated effects. Average improvement alone does not describe individual outcomes.
An evaluation should test whether the comparison axis activates before scaling to more datasets and rankers.
Secure artifact publishing excludes credentials private logs raw user identifiers and copyrighted evaluation data.
